open_items: CLI lookup/dispatch and selected/configured scopes remain separate integrations. Native materialization supports a missing destination under a private owned canonical Linux parent; no resume, atomic whole-directory publication or cross-platform write claim.

Baseline comparison now uses the shared 10.f source adapter; unsupported resource deltas still fail explicitly. Snapshot integrity and materialization do not prove historical full validation, original-project completeness, authorship, approvals or release readiness.

oracle.requirement_contract: Eine Baseline MUSS aufgrund ihrer Snapshotobjekte ohne Git-Commit verifizierbar, materialisierbar und vergleichbar bleiben; ein zugehöriger Git-Commit ist ausschließlich optionale Provenienz.
oracle.scope: Fresh stored-manifest integrity view and independent materialization of the already supported unconfigured whole-project snapshot; all semantic and binary bytes come from verified archived objects. Capture completion rechecks the selected native record and actual archived objects. Missing records and missing objects have distinct path-bound diagnostics; host access denial and safety violations remain errors. Legacy schema migration/readers are not inferred from current data.

preconditions: Explicit Baseline record bytes, actual archive objects and a private owned external destination parent; every protected boundary is declared.
steps: Read stored Baseline data with freshly recomputed integrity, without writes or cached success.
Restore the verified whole-project snapshot without Git or current files, preserving exact resource bytes and semantic configuration hashes; reconstruct the root again from actual output bytes.
Reject missing archive objects, existing or overlapping destinations and invalid operational choices before publication; retain interrupted output without overwriting or claiming completion.
Inject missing/replaced destination directories and ensure no write falls back to the process cwd; reject foreign directories and byte-identical replacement of an owned file.
Check original objects again after output reconstruction, preserving actual interrupted files on late source/storage failure; restore an older Baseline and registry without any original project.
Re-run the unchanged W/R behavior tests after separating the unchanged read-only view from native materialization.
Compare verified Baseline pairs through the shared source registry and semantic diff, including successive stored history and independent materialized-project comparison.

Reject a missing or concurrently changed native Baseline record and missing archive bytes throughout capture; preserve exact missing-object paths and host/security failures. Reject foreign projects and unsupported historical schemas; compare committed Git bytes without checkout.
